task_specification.objective: Deliver a closure-ready release-contract increment that restores authored cemetery spatial integrity and upgrades level-up choices to an authored, navigable visual hierarchy.

diagnosis.root_cause: The authored cemetery package, gameplay datum, collision overlays, and shipped camera visibility contract remain insufficiently integrated: prior numeric camera tuning still produced only about 0.2 projected visibility for the central landmark during movement, indicating transform-space/sight-lane mismatch rather than a single framing value.

stop_conditions: Preserve the intact authored cemetery package and its native streets, buildings, props, materials, and landmarks; do not replace, split, hide, extract, duplicate, or surgically edit package children.
Do not expand scope into deferred lighting/exposure, dense-performance qualification, weapons, audio, or unrelated run systems.
Stop after the central landmark and perimeter are collision-safe and visible during movement replay, and level-up choices satisfy the complete visual and input hierarchy contract.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from repeated camera transform tuning: restore one transform-space contract across the intact authored instance, gameplay datum, collision/navigation/spawn anchors, and camera sight lanes, while completing the required upgrade-choice visual hierarchy in the same release-contract pass.

code: Run existing Godot boot, import, scene-integrity, and native project preservation checks after the bounded release-contract edit.
Confirm the authored cemetery remains a single intact runtime instance and no package child meshes or source assets were replaced or split.
Exercise upgrade-draft data bindings to verify each displayed delta is truthful, limited to three, and uses no placeholder CURRENT values.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester recaptures the same shipped camera at spawn, critical route, near-contact, after-departure, and cardinal/landmark viewpoints, paired with runtime_state and movement input steps.

Replay ordinary movement around every side of the central landmark and along the full boundary/perimeter; verify collision, navigation, spawn exclusion, and objective anchors, with no pass-through, disappearance, occlusion drift, void, or proxy-floor exposure.
Open the level-up draft and exercise mouse, keyboard, and gamepad focus/confirm/cancel paths; verify silhouettes/icons, current-to-new values, and no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas.
Re-run release_convergence_complete_run_release_contract plus host_godot_boot and native_godot_project preservation checks.
visual: Compare shipped gameplay frames against the bound cemetery reference for high-angle framing, larger traversable scale, external depth, readable central landmark silhouette, coherent route/escape lanes, and stable visibility under movement.

Compare level-up frames for authored choice hierarchy/visual hierarchy, readable silhouettes/icons, restrained copy, truthful current-to-new values, and distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.

done_when: The playable cemetery route can expand to a larger traversable scale while retaining a readable loop and cross-route.
A coherent external world or external depth remains visible beyond the gameplay boundary/perimeter without exposed void, proxy floor, or accidental reachable spawn space.
The central building/landmark is visible from spawn, the critical route, near-contact, after-departure, and cardinal/landmark viewpoints during ordinary movement/movement replay.
Visible landmark footprints and collision shapes agree in the same transform space; the player and representative enemies cannot pass through the central building or perimeter boundary.
There is no landmark disappearance or camera occlusion drift while the landmark remains gameplay-relevant; no camera owner hard-hides the whole landmark.
Navigation, spawn exclusion, objective anchors, and camera framing remain aligned with authored streets and preserve at least one useful escape direction.
Level-up weapon and upgrade choices replace text-stacked cards with a clear choice hierarchy/visual hierarchy using authored weapon or upgrade silhouettes/icons and restrained copy.

Each choice presents truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; unchanged or exhaustive rows are omitted and NEW or LOCKED never appears as a placeholder in the CURRENT column when no current value exists is not applicable to that choice style. Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states are visibly distinct, complete, and operable through confirm/cancel or.
tasks.instructions: Repair the active arena camera-occlusion issue as a single release-contract integration pass. Inspect the existing native cemetery instance and rebase its gameplay datum, collision, navigation, spawn/objective anchors, and shipped camera sight lanes so they share one authoritative transform space. If the current package wrapper or support geometry is causing the landmark to fall out of the camera contract, repair that binding or isolate the support layer instead of applying another isolated numeric camera tweak. The arena must expand to a larger traversable scale, show coherent external world/external depth beyond the boundary/perimeter, and keep the central building/landmark readable during ordinary movement/movement replay. Collision must match visible geometry on every side of the landmark and along the perimeter; prevent pass-through, disappearance, and occlusion without hiding the whole landmark. Keep the authored package as one intact runtime instance and add only minimal outer datum, collision, navigation, spawn, objective, or bounded visibility helpers required for integration. In the same task, implement the required upgrade-choice choice hierarchy/visual hierarchy: replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with authored silhouettes/icons, show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, omit unchanged or exhaustive rows, never use NEW or LOCKED as a placeholder in the CURRENT value column, and provide complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states with clear confirm/cancel behavior. Preserve existing combat and run-state ownership. Any tester-only preparation/advance hooks must remain editor-only, use authoritative gameplay APIs, expose requested/resolved/reset-isolation receipts, and be unavailable in release exports; Tester/Runtime owns recapture and verdict.
